reading.folded: a triangle whose world orientation (the sign of its signed area) at the frame is the opposite of its orientation at the setup pose — the rest table's vertices, the setup pose's bones with no deform. A triangle degenerate at the frame is not counted there
reading.degenerate: a triangle whose height over its longest edge is at most 9.313225746154785e-10 of the largest coordinate magnitude its attachment holds at that pose, in world space or in its UVs — thinner than the posed numbers resolve
reading.inverted: a triangle drawn mirrored against the rest of its mesh at the setup pose: the sign of world area x UV area is the opposite of the mesh's own sense (that product summed over its triangles, weighted by world area). Setup faults are listed once and never counted as folds
reading.index: a triangle is named by its index i in the rest table: vertices triangles[3i], triangles[3i+1], triangles[3i+2]
reading.box: a frame's box is [minX, minY, maxX, maxY] in world units (y up) over every vertex of that frame's folded triangles as posed there, and nothing else
reading.area: a frame's area is its folded triangles' unsigned areas at the setup pose (the rest table), summed, in world units²; share is that over the mesh's area, every triangle's unsigned setup-pose area summed. The setup pose's, not the frame's: a folded triangle's posed area passes through 0 as it turns, so it says how far the turn has gone rather than how much art is turned over
